Name: Dwarf sells Loved gems artifacts ETC
Author: sadnumbme
Description:
Dwarf sells loved gems, artifacts, ETC
The mines are full of artifacts, gems, geodes and minerals. It would be easy for the Dwarf to get these items. You will find loved gifts and items used in crafting and fish pond quests.   You have the option to sell or not by sections.
